title: HyperEdit Common Artifact Fields
description: Shared base fields required in every numbered HyperEdit artifact

status.description: Artifact outcome: pass = all gates cleared, warn = non-blocking issues, fail = blocking issue, pending = not yet run

blocking_issues.description: List of issues that prevent downstream stages from running. Empty array if none.

assumptions.description: Decisions made without explicit instruction — downstream agents should verify.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that may require human input or further investigation.

source_references.description: Files, URLs, or artifacts consulted to produce this output.

project_id.description: Project identifier matching the run-ledger project_id.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced this artifact.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when artifact was written.

agent_version.description: Skill version or commit hash that produced this artifact.
